spec_match.rationale: Fixed in this refile: the live probe now reads renderQuantumSize — the attribute the spec actually exposes — instead of the nonexistent ctx.renderSizeHint the v151 copy printed, and the feature-detect sample uses 'renderQuantumSize' in AudioContext.prototype instead of a bogus prototype check for the dictionary member.

interactive.rationale: Three tabs with best/ok/avoid patterns, copyable code, and a real per-tab AudioContext probe reporting sampleRate, latencies, state, and quantum.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise matches the page's verified behaviour.

edge_cases.rationale: Missing AudioContext and constructor errors have honest branches; the missing-attribute readout explains the ignored hint and the anticipated milestone.

references.rationale: A see-also section with the ChromeStatus entry and spec link was added in this refile (the v151 page had none).

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite ran in the verification browser at 5 pass / 4 fail / 0 blocked — the 4 fails are the shipped-attribute assertions, the honest 'not yet shipped' answer on Chromium 141 (anticipated Chrome 153), exactly as their descriptions state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141 with autoplay permitted): the Instrument probe — broken in v151 because probeAC('instrument') targeted ids prefixed inst- — now renders its full readout after the id fix; player and voip probes verified too; honest 'not exposed' quantum line; zero console errors on the final run; screenshot v153-rq-ux.png read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts rq-ux-probe-ran per probe with tab id, hint, and quantum readout.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons that override background also override color; small-text emerald readouts darkened via color-mix to meet AA.

accessibility.rationale: Demo outputs are role=status aria-live=polite (added in this refile); tabs are real buttons; badges pair colour with the BEST/OK/AVOID text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/webaudio-configurable-render-quantum --no-server: desktop OK clean, mobile OK (sub-44px flags are inline links, primary buttons/sliders remain usable); both screenshots read and judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a build where the Chrome 153 flip has landed
openQuestions.detail: The verification browser (Chromium 141, no origin trial) does not expose renderQuantumSize, so every hint is honestly reported as ignored. Once a Chrome 153 stable (or a build launched with --enable-blink-features=WebAudioConfigurableRenderQuantum) is available, re-run the page and confirm the quantum readouts flip to real values and the four not-yet conformance assertions pass.

guidanceConsulted.query: web audio start stop controls live metrics readout accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give async result areas polite live regions, keep state changes textual, and disable/re-enable controls around async work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probe outputs upgraded to role=status live regions; recommendations stay textual with badge labels.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Driver run: probe output text announced for all three tabs

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let card grids collapse to one column on narrow viewports and keep wide code blocks scrolling inside their own container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Code blocks scroll in their own container; tab row and demo rows wrap.

summary: v153 refile fixing two real v151 defects: the Instrument tab's probe crashed on null elements (id mismatch) and the probe printed the nonexistent ctx.renderSizeHint property — it now reports renderQuantumSize, and the fallback-detection code sample teaches the correct 'renderQuantumSize' in prototype check. Verified via CDP headless Chromium 141: all three tab probes run clean.
